title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: In k-Means clustering, the algorithm assigns each point to the nearest cluster center and then recalculates the cluster centers based on the mean of the points assigned to each cluster.

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: Initially, cluster A has a center at $$(0,5)$$ and cluster B has a center at $$(6,0)$$.

title: Assigning Teams to Clusters
text: Calculate the distance of each team from the initial cluster centers to determine which cluster they belong to.

title: Calculate Distance for Team O-Ski
text: Calculate the distance of Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$ from the initial cluster centers $$(0,5)$$ and $$(6,0)$$.

title: Calculate Distance for Team SantaQlaus
text: Calculate the distance of Team SantaQlaus $$(3,1)$$ from the initial cluster centers $$(0,5)$$ and $$(6,0)$$.

title: Calculate Distance for Team Pandas
text: Calculate the distance of Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ from the initial cluster centers $$(0,5)$$ and $$(6,0)$$.

title: Calculate Distance for Team Ice-berk
text: Calculate the distance of Team Ice-berk $$(1,5)$$ from the initial cluster centers $$(0,5)$$ and $$(6,0)$$.

title: Recalculate Cluster Centers
text: After assigning teams to clusters based on the shortest distance, recalculate the cluster centers by finding the mean of the points in each cluster.

title: Calculate New Center for Cluster A
text: Assuming teams O-Ski and Ice-berk are in cluster A, calculate the new center by averaging their coordinates.

title: Calculate New Center for Cluster B
text: Assuming teams SantaQlaus and Pandas are in cluster B, calculate the new center by averaging their coordinates.

title: Converged Cluster Centers
text: The algorithm converges when the cluster centers no longer change significantly. Calculate the final centers for clusters A and B.
